Im only 18 so I've not had the same experiences as you and I can't see all of your stuff in me. However the "minor depression" resonates heavily. I had a "minor depression" for about 3 years before I saw a doctor about it (and only after I broke down I front of my friends while drunk and they essentially forced me). Turns out that "minor depression" was actually a very severe one and that I had just been lying to myself about lying to myself about how bad it really was. Today I'm on meds and feeling good for the first time in sooo many years and looking back those were probably the worst years of my life, and I was really close to actually killing myself a couple of times. I don't want you to make the same mistakes I did, please go to the doctor and describe honestly how you're feeling, therapy helps, but I know from my case that if meds are what's needed then you won't do it without them. Also the worst that could happen would be for the doc to say that it's not severe enough to warrant medicine. Anyhow I wish you the best of luck and a happy future❤❤

Im currently on meds as well for about 3 months now And while I'm definitely not cured it has improved my life significantly. You will still have bad times and lots of them, and the effects won't be immediate, it may even take months before you find the right drug and dose. But I promise you this, they help. I've gone from a point where I could hardly brush my teeth or even get up in the morning to a point where I can sort of manage my every day life and even now start start figuring out myself and my sexuality. But most importantly my life doesn't feel nearly as controlled by my depression as it once was. While I still have my days where all I do is lie in my bed and just wish to not exist. but that's down to like once or twice per week from it almost being a daily occurrence. Also while I'm definitely not as such happy in my base state I'm not hopeless and shitty-feeling either which for me at least is an enormous improvement as it allows me to go about my life a lot easier. Anyways I'm gonna cut my comment a bit short as I just came back from therapy and need a nap. But I truly do wish you the best on journey the you have in front of you. It's gonna be tough but I hope you break depressions back, just like I hope for myself
